description: This file defines a Java interface 'JsonValueAssertable' which specifies assertion methods for verifying various properties of JSON values, such as being an array, object, boolean, null, number, or string, with support for method chaining.

classes.name: JsonValueAssertable
classes.description: An interface providing assertion methods for verifying JSON value types and properties, supporting method chaining, and including a method to verify unsupported operations.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNotArray
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not an array.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isNotObject
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not an object.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNotBoolean
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not a boolean.

methods.name: isNullLiteral
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not null.

methods.name: isNotNullLiteral
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not null.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isNotNumber
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not a number.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isNotString
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON value is not a string.

methods.name: doesNotSupport
methods.description: Verifies that invoking the specified Consumer on a JsonValue leads to an UnsupportedOperationException.
